home:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptional finished desktop HOME screen visual prototype for an original Roblox arcade game titled TRAIL WARS. Wide 16:9 screen, straight-on crisp interface, no monitor/device/browser surround. This is a high fidelity art-directed GAME UI mockup, not a website or a vector wireframe. Aim for the production finish of the best vibrant Roblox cartoon interfaces: substantial custom illustrated icons, very readable thick rounded display lettering with dark indigo outline and a small offset shadow, physically beveled glossy buttons with upper highlights and darker lower extrusion, polished graphic artwork throughout.

Original Trail Wars identity: saturated electric turquoise, cobalt and rich indigo paired with hot tangerine PLAY controls and small golden accents. Retain friendly navy ink and tiny warm-white highlights, but absolutely avoid the previous flat muted cream/mint minimal look. Restrained saturation hierarchy: cobalt/turquoise environment, warm orange primary CTA. Consistent materials and lighting.

Composition: beautifully designed asymmetric HOME, no scrolling. Original illustrated TRAIL WARS wordmark prominent upper left: thick cream-white TRAIL over orange WARS with indigo dimensional outline and a bright cyan swooping racing trail. Small polished coin balance upper right reads "480". A compact vertical menu down the left occupies roughly 22% width; four beautifully finished distinct 3D cartoon icons and readable labels "CUSTOMIZE", "SHOP", "PROFILE", "SETTINGS". Icons respectively a little racing paint tool/visor, pit-stop shopping bag, pilot badge, mechanical sliders; no generic emoji, no pets or eggs. Each secondary control has coordinated cobalt/indigo enamel trim, modest depth, generous spacing.
Main central/right artwork is an original miniature Trail Wars demonstration board seen straight-on, broad rectangular 1300:800 proportions, cyan/blue low-detail interior with colorful orange, yellow and magenta curving racing trails. Show a handful of tiny racers for a readable gameplay illustration, and a single larger original hover-core breaking the frame at the lower-right edge as a decorative character illustration. This larger hero is a TOY RACER: glossy rounded orange aerodynamic pod, dark friendly two-eye visor, small rear fins, cyan hovering ring. No animals, pet faces, egg shape, chests, humanoid avatars or lobby. Include one small original finned rocket above a trail. Character art should have convincing volume, contact shadows, bright rim lighting, carefully controlled specular highlights and confident indigo outlines. The trails are clearly separate and legible.
A confident short heading above the board reads "LEAVE YOUR MARK!" in large outlined rounded white type. Below the board, one exceptionally crafted wide orange PLAY button, bold white outlined text "PLAY" and a custom cream triangle icon, substantial but controlled pressed-depth styling. Near it a small readable descriptor "3 ROUNDS • HOMING + JUMP". Secondary quiet line "Turn. Trail. Outlast." No daily reward, no battle pass, no fake match statistics, no new features. Include tiny bottom-right label "DESIGN PROTOTYPE • SAMPLE DATA".
Background: original abstract arcade starting-grid curves, softly lit cobalt shapes and subtle directional streaks, not a 3D simulator lobby. Give artwork plenty of room; do not wallpaper the interface with sparks. NO pasted reference-game layout, branding, currency art, eggs, pets or purchase mechanics. Make this look like a desirable, professionally shipped cartoon game Home with a coherent native-game UI language, not generic cards with extra borders. All specified text clean and accurately spelled.
shop:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished desktop SHOP screen visual prototype for original TRAIL WARS Roblox arcade game, wide 16:9 straight-on screen, no browser/device framing.
Input image role: the supplied Trail Wars HOME image is a visual-system reference ONLY: preserve its original racer artwork language, electric cobalt/turquoise/indigo palette, warm orange action buttons, dimensional cream-white rounded type with indigo outlines, high quality custom icons, convincing glossy enamel bevels and small hard shadows. Build a NEW SHOP composition, do not edit or repeat Home. Deliver a genuinely polished premium Roblox cartoon interface matching or surpassing the finish of that image.

Original asymmetric shop: a large elegantly organized showroom panel centered over a softly blurred, darkened cobalt abstract arcade background. This is a 2D graphical store UI, not a 3D lobby. Main header upper left has a small original TRAIL WARS wordmark and large outlined "SHOP"; smaller subtitle "LOOKS ONLY. SAME RULES." Below the header, beautiful chunky category tabs "ALL", "CORES", "TRAILS", each with a custom small illustrated icon; ALL clearly selected in yellow-orange enamel, others dark cobalt. Coin balance top right is "480" with the same original golden racing coin as Home. A substantial red glossy X close button in the panel's top-right corner, visually separate from the currency. No copied pet-game composition.

Exactly FOUR EXISTING COSMETICS, no other products or invented mechanics:
LEFT prominent hero product, about 42% of content width and full content height: "RING CORE", price "150" with a golden coin icon on a gorgeous orange purchase/inspect button. Centerpiece is a large original hollow turquoise/cyan TORUS CORE with a small rear racing fin and reflective enamel rim, an unmistakable circular central hole, floating above a small illustrative display plinth. It is a cosmetic racing core, NOT a ring to wear, egg, animal, pet or wheel/tire. Deep indigo-to-turquoise racing-track theme behind it, controlled radial light and a few detailed sparkles; a small integrated ribbon reads "CORE". Lower readable descriptor "A clean new silhouette." Strong depth, beautiful edge highlights, careful soft shadow. This is the anchor of the store.
RIGHT upper wide product: "DASHED TRAIL", price "100" with coin icon on orange price button. Original artwork shows a thick rhythmic cyan-to-blue segmented racing trail sweeping through a dramatic curve, not an animal or ribbon gift. Contrasting vibrant blue-violet racing theme, disciplined diagonal accents, tasteful highlights. Small tag "TRAIL". Descriptor "Leave a different line." It must look visibly different from the Ring Core card, not merely the same card recolored.
RIGHT lower TWO smaller supporting product tiles side-by-side: "STARTER CORE" showing the glossy friendly orange hover-core with dark two-eye visor and tiny mechanical tail fins from the reference Home, on an amber/blue lit background. Clear teal-green status button "OWNED". "STARTER TRAIL" showing a smooth continuous orange racing trail on a turquoise background, status "OWNED". No price for owned starter items. A single clear check symbol on each owned state.
The small product family can share consistent corners/outline thickness but composition and illustrations must vary deliberately. Feature art overlaps background shapes but never overlaps text or price buttons. Large rounded typography with cream-white face, navy outline and subtle readable shadow. Card surfaces have subtle custom racing-chevron texture and real dimensional rims; outlines and highlights are controlled, not a mass of duplicated borders. Original shop bag / core ring / trail artwork should be production quality.
At the bottom of the main panel a quiet note "COSMETICS ONLY" and a tiny footer "DESIGN PROTOTYPE • SAMPLE DATA • NO LIVE PURCHASES".
Do NOT add pets, eggs, loot boxes, chance percentages, bundle deals, sales timers, rarity systems, premium passes, fake discounts, power boosts or copied game assets. Prices are earned coins only, not Robux. Exact specified words, accurate spelling, clean text at real desktop size. No generic flat vector placeholders, emoji, muted minimalist website cards or pasted screenshot backgrounds. The final screen should have the rich, vibrant, handcrafted illustrated finish of a top-tier cartoon Roblox game, with orderly hierarchy and generous readable spacing.
